### Q96: the fast-check run seed is printed, and a re-run with it draws the same cases. FIXED (CONFIRMED)

The checker's probe ran in the mirror with the real `vitest.config.ts`. It used two probe test files, in the kernel and
the tables projects, that record unseeded default `fc.assert` draws, named-import `assert` draws, `fc.double`, unseeded
`fc.sample`, an own-seed property and an `fc.check` counterexample and seed.
- **Unset:** exactly **one** line on stderr for the two-project run:
  `fast-check: PLAT_FUZZ_SEED is unset; this run's seed is 1923920166 — every property without a seed of its own draws from it, and a re-run with PLAT_FUZZ_SEED=1923920166 draws the same cases (Q96, C-0057)`.
- **Re-run with `PLAT_FUZZ_SEED=1923920166`:** no line, and every draw is identical in both projects. The only
  difference is `readConfigureGlobal().seed`: null when unset, by design, so `fuzzParams` and `replaySeed` are
  unchanged.
- **The same set seed under HEAD's setup and config:** byte-identical output to the new code's set-seed run. So no
  suite's draws change under a set seed.
- **HEAD's code with the seed unset:** different draws on every run and no line printed. This is the defect.
- The five runs of this check printed five different seeds.
- **Setup cross-section at PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000, W=1:** one fast-check test file per test folder of every package
  project, plus `testkit/oracles/report.test.ts`. **46 files, 575/575**, exit 0.
